hints.title: Coinless Leaf Pruning
hints.text: Any leaf node containing 0 coins will never need to be visited. Iteratively prune all coinless leaves from the tree.

hints.title: Two-Step Reach Allowance
hints.text: Coins can be collected from up to distance 2 away. This means you do not need to walk to leaf nodes with coins, nor their immediate parents.

hints.title: Pruning Two Outer Layers
hints.text: After removing all coinless leaves, prune the current leaves once, and then prune the newly created leaves a second time.

hints.title: Topological Leaf Pruning Implementation

variables: n: number of vertices in tree
complexity.notes: Each vertex and edge is processed at most a constant number of times during pruning.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all patrol paths is an NP-hard variant of Traveling Salesperson.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prunes zero-coin leaves then removes two outer layers of coin leaves.
